days.title: Label vs. reality: Berlin's 'good location' addresses
days.question: Do addresses labelled 'good location' in Berlin's rent index really cost more?
days.finding: About 400,000 addresses: 'good' locations pay about 21 % more than 'simple' ones, but many blocks contradict their label.

days.title: Trees are not enough
days.question: Which Leipzig streets lack effective tree canopy, and where does that meet summer heat?
days.finding: 514 km of street have little canopy and are among the hottest third. Count is not cover.

days.title: Frankfurt 2035: land value dynamics & scenarios
days.question: How did official land values change 2022–2026, and where could they go by 2035?
days.finding: Residential land −4 %, mixed use −18 %, commercial +6 %. What-if scenarios to 2035 and 291,000 buildings in 3D.

days.title: Where Berlin brews: a week in coffee clusters
days.question: Where do Berlin's cafés cluster, and how do the clusters change hour by hour?
days.finding: 45 café clusters at Wednesday lunch, 6 on Friday at 21:30, one on Saturday at 23:30.

days.title: Frankfurt's giants: who gets the sun?
days.question: How do Frankfurt's buildings of 30 m and more shade the streets and rooftops around them, across the year?
days.finding: On 21 June, 4.1 km² of streets and rooftops lose 3+ hours of direct sun to 1,843 buildings of 30 m and more, cast onto real LoD2 roofs.

days.title: The Names We Left Behind: Istanbul's forgotten place names
days.question: Which of Istanbul's old place names survive only as old_name in OpenStreetMap, and what kind of renaming hides behind them?
days.finding: 161 places still carry an old name in OpenStreetMap, from Christea Turris (Galata Tower) and Myrelaion (Bodrum Mosque) to Boğaziçi Köprüsü and Nef Stadyumu.

days.title: Christmas Is Loading… Europe's Christmas markets, 2026
days.question: Where are Europe's Christmas markets in OpenStreetMap, and when does each open in 2026?
days.finding: 1,265 markets mapped. At the peak of the season around 600 are open on the same day; 7 large markets have checked 2026 dates.

days.title: Die Dachrepublik: what if Munich's roofs belonged to everyone?
days.question: If the flat roofs of Munich's city centre were shared among seven public uses and solar PV, who would gain access, and how many roofs would we actually need?
days.finding: With the default shares, 446 roofs close most service gaps and 2,397 flat roofs stay free. Residents with all seven uses within walking distance rise from 0% to 50%.
